01

Artist booking & management

A direct connection between artists, promoters and venues, supported by the work that turns an enquiry into a considered performance.

  • Talent selection and artist availability for clubs, festivals, private events and brand experiences.
  • Booking enquiries, performance briefs, fee discussions and coordination between artist and promoter.
  • Show advancing: set times, technical and hospitality requirements, travel and event communication.
  • Artist positioning, EPKs, release planning and career-development guidance.

Start with your event date, location, audience and the kind of performance you want to create.

Discuss an artist booking ↗
02

Music curation & programming

A music identity shaped around a venue, its audience and the changing energy of the room.

  • Music direction for hospitality spaces, restaurants, hotels, clubs and brand environments.
  • Resident-DJ selection, talent sourcing, line-up planning and programme schedules.
  • Programming across daytime, sunset and late-night sessions, with a considered progression in sound.
  • Briefing artists and reviewing how the programme fits the space and guest experience.

Useful for a new venue, an existing residency or a space ready to rethink its sound.

Shape your venue’s sound ↗
03

Events & live experiences

Creative and practical support across an event, from the first concept to the coordination behind the experience.

  • Event concepts, experience design, audience positioning and creative direction.
  • Artist line-ups, talent coordination, production briefs and supplier communication.
  • Project management, production schedules, run-of-show planning and on-the-day coordination.
  • Concerts, label showcases, intimate gatherings, brand activations and collaborative experiences.

Tell us the scale, location and stage of planning. We can shape the brief around the support you need.

Plan an experience ↗
04

Branding & creative production

Build a clear identity, then carry it consistently through the material people see, hear and experience.

  • Brand strategy, positioning, naming direction and visual-identity development.
  • Logo systems, typography, colour, brand guidelines and graphic design.
  • Release artwork, campaigns, editorial layouts, event material and social content.
  • Photography, film, content concepts and creative direction across a coordinated production brief.

For a first identity, a brand refresh or a specific campaign. Scope follows your goals and available material.

Build a creative brief ↗
05

Websites & digital experiences

Digital spaces that express a brand clearly and help people find information, explore work and take action.

  • Website planning, information architecture, content structure and user journeys.
  • Responsive visual design, interactive prototypes and accessible navigation.
  • Artist, agency, publication, event and company websites with clear enquiry pathways.
  • Digital-product concepts, interface design and creative prototypes for new ventures.

We begin with what the visitor needs to do, then connect the design, content and interactions around it.

Discuss a digital project ↗
06

Consultancy & new ventures

Practical direction for artists, independent businesses and people developing a new creative idea.

  • Artist positioning, music-business direction and release/campaign planning.
  • Brand foundations, audience definition and creative strategy for startups.
  • Concept development, product thinking and early digital prototypes.
  • A focused consultation or an ongoing project brief, depending on the work required.

Bring the idea, the challenge and the decisions you need to make. We will identify a useful starting point.
